lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ba8Y4Ta4O24 (reduced formula Ba2YTaO6) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies octahedral Ta and Y centers, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Ba shows a close-packed-like arrangement of 12 O neighbors; the O centers bridge one Ta and one Y. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-sharing between Ta and Y octahedra, plus face-sharing between the 12-vertex Ba polyhedra and the Ta and Y octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites.
